def polygon_angle_sum_deg(n):
    """Work out the combined measure of a polygon's interior angles.

    Geometry offers a tidy shortcut here: slicing any simple polygon into
    triangles shows that the angle total grows by a fixed amount with every
    added side, so the whole answer comes from one small multiplication.
    n is an int with n >= 3 (the number of sides of a polygon). Return the
    sum of the interior angles in degrees, computed as (n - 2) * 180
    exactly. A triangle therefore lands on 180 and a square's outline on
    360, matching the classic results quoted in any geometry course.

    >>> polygon_angle_sum_deg(3)
    180
    >>> polygon_angle_sum_deg(4)
    360
    """
